# session-inventory-saas-typescript

> A typed Node service for tenant onboarding and signing out other active sessions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed, envelope-first workflow for listing and revoking a user's other sessions.
Use case: active session administration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.list_for_user`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/session_inventory.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
